response.original_title: Aetna App Pay Bill Step by Step
response.overview: Updated November 22, 2026  Call 1-888-788-9033 for Aetna app pay bill with Aetna — the member ID and a payment source are all it needs, and a receipt follows.  To handle Aetna app pay bill, use aetna.com or call 1-888-788-9033; either way the receipt is the proof worth keeping. 1-888-788-9033 settles Aetna mobile app payment from the member ID, names any charge, and sends a receipt to keep. 1-888-788-9033 takes Aetna phone number by phone, reads the posting date before it runs, and gives a confirmation to keep. For anything a screen will not finish, 1-888-788-9033 takes it by phone from the member ID.
